description: Create an inbox and return it, including the email address that is its inboxId. Optionally choose the username, domain, display name, and metadata; creating again with the same clientId returns the inbox it already created.

clientId.description: Your idempotency key: creating again with the same clientId returns the existing inbox

displayName.description: Sender name recipients see; "AgentMail" when omitted, and an empty string sends none

domain.description: Domain of the address, agentmail.to when omitted; a custom domain must be verified first

metadata.description: Your own key-value data, stored on the inbox and returned with it; recipients never see it

signature.description: Signature AgentMail adds to every message this inbox sends, after your content and above any quoted message; not added again when the body already contains it

html.description: HTML version for the HTML part, at most 4,000 characters; link a logo by URL. When omitted, the HTML part gets text

text.description: Signature for the plain-text part, at most 1,000 characters; line breaks are kept

username.description: Part of the address before the @; a random one is generated when omitted
